NAVIGATIONAL WARNING NO. PL 213/2026 (NAVTEX)
CATEGORY: SECURITY-RELATED REQUIREMENTS
AREA: SOUTHERN BALTIC. LOCALISATION: POLISH COAST, POMERANIAN BAY. CHART INT1295.
DUE TO MILITARY EXERCISES AREA BOUNDED BY POSITIONS 1. 54-03.73N 014-27.88E 2. 54-11.45N 014-36.38E 3. 54-13.51N 014-46.88E 4. 54-10.31N 014-48.78E IS TEMPORARILY DANGEROUS FOR SHIPPING AND FISHERY: ON 2026-09-07 FROM 12:00 TO 13:00 ON 2026-09-10 FROM 19:00 TO 21:00 TIME IN UTC
TERM OF VALIDITY: FROM 07 SEP 2026, 12:00 (UTC) TO 10 SEP 2026, 21:00 (UTC)
REMARKS: EXTREME CAUTION ADVISED
PROMULGATED 03 SEP 2026. HYDROGRAPHIC OFFICE OF THE POLISH NAVY, POLISH COORDINATOR OF RADIO NAVIGATIONAL WARNINGS.
